snippet.title: Tour de France 2015 on Consoles: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Site: http://www.letour-games.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ProCyclingManager
Twitter: http://twitter.com/PCyclingManager
Devblog: http://devblog.cycling-manager.com/

The official Tour de France 2015 video games are developed by Cyanide Studio to please fans of cycling and simulation lovers more and more every year. While management aficionados will get their dose of strategy with Pro Cycling Manager 2015 on PC, cycling fans will also enjoy all the most thrilling sensations of the Tour de France 2015 on consoles. Today’s gameplay trailer shows more about the console versions of the Tour de France 2015 video games on PS4, PS3 and Xbox One!

Take part in a Tour de France 2015 packed with new features, and play as one of today's top champions in your attempt to win the coveted yellow jersey. Experience the rollercoaster of emotions of a professional rider through the 21 official stages of the Tour and, in their first appearance this year, the Critérium International and the Critérium du Dauphiné. Attack, use the most efficient trajectory, adopt the best strategy, issue orders to your teammates and manage your effort effectively! Build your dream team in ProTeam mode and recruit legendary pro cyclists. Discover the new Challenge mode to test your descent skills. Finally, play in cooperative and versus multiplayer with a friend in local play! 

WHAT’S NEW ON THE 2015’s CONSOLE VERSIONS?

- Unprecedented immersion
New routes, landmarks, sceneries, improved graphics, crowd full of life and more, will further enhance your sensation of being at the center of the exciting events. 
- Upgraded interface
The in-race interface has been redesigned to provide instant access to any information: effort, energy, feeds, position in the peloton, stage profile, wind direction and more.
- Pro Team mode upgraded
To prepare the Tour de France, play the Dauphiné and the Critérium International every season. Achieve your race objectives and recruit to build your dream team. 
- New game mode: Challenge
Test your skills as a descender! We challenge you to descend the cols via the technical route to beat the reference times!

The official games of the Tour de France will release on PS4, PS3, Xbox One and PC this June.
